namespace Nl2LeanExpected
theorem sprint_development_0052 {α : Type*} {R : α → α → Prop} {l : List α} (h : List.Pairwise R l) (p : List α) (hp : p = l.permute (List.range l.length)) : List.Pairwise R p := by sorry
end Nl2LeanExpected

namespace Nl2LeanCandidate
theorem sprint_development_0052 {α : Type*} {R : α → α → Prop} {l : List α} (h : List.Pairwise R l) (p : List α) (hp : p = l.permute (List.range l.length)) : List.Pairwise R p :=
  by
  rw [hp]
  apply List.Pairwise.permute_of_pairwise h
  intros x y hx hy
  rw [List.permute_nth]
  apply h
  exact hx
  exact hy
end Nl2LeanCandidate
